name: Selfie Aesthetic Edit
summary: Turn close-up selfie clips into a beat-locked aesthetic edit with stutter holds and blur whips, as a new editable Draft.

compatibility.selects: Development build only. Released-version compatibility is unverified. Requires Panel runScript and Draft authoring; uses the ffmpeg bundled with Selects, so nothing else needs installing. Windows x64 hands-on verification is still pending.

de.name: Selfie Aesthetic Edit
de.summary: Macht aus Selfie-Nahaufnahmen einen beatsynchronen Aesthetic-Edit mit Stotter-Wiederholungen und Blur-Whips als neuen, bearbeitbaren Draft.

en.name: Selfie Aesthetic Edit
en.summary: Turn close-up selfie clips into a beat-locked aesthetic edit with stutter holds and blur whips, as a new editable Draft.

es.name: Selfie Aesthetic Edit
es.summary: Convierte clips de selfis en primer plano en un edit estético sincronizado con el ritmo, con repeticiones entrecortadas y whips con desenfoque, como un nuevo Draft editable.

fr.name: Selfie Aesthetic Edit
fr.summary: Transforme des clips de selfies en gros plan en un montage esthétique calé sur le rythme, avec des répétitions saccadées et des whips flous, dans un nouveau Draft modifiable.

it.name: Selfie Aesthetic Edit
it.summary: Trasforma le clip di selfie in primo piano in un montaggio estetico a tempo di musica, con ripetizioni a scatti e whip sfocati, come nuovo Draft modificabile.

ja.name: Selfie Aesthetic Edit
ja.summary: 顔のアップのセルフィー動画を、ビートに合わせたスタッター反復とブラーホイップ付きのエステティック編集にして、編集可能な新しい Draft として作成します。

ko.name: Selfie Aesthetic Edit
ko.summary: 얼굴 클로즈업 셀피 영상을 비트에 맞춘 스터터 반복과 블러 휩이 들어간 감성 편집으로 만들어, 편집 가능한 새 Draft로 저장합니다.

pt.name: Selfie Aesthetic Edit
pt.summary: Transforma clipes de selfies em close em uma edição estética no ritmo da música, com repetições em stutter e whips com desfoque, como um novo Draft editável.

tr.name: Selfie Aesthetic Edit
tr.summary: Yakın çekim selfie klipleri, ritme kilitli, takılan tekrarlar ve bulanık whip geçişleri içeren estetik bir kurguya dönüştürür ve düzenlenebilir yeni bir Draft olarak kaydeder.

zh.name: Selfie Aesthetic Edit
zh.summary: 将自拍特写片段剪成卡点的氛围感混剪，带顿挫重复和模糊甩镜，并保存为可编辑的新 Draft。

inputs.label: Close-up selfie clips and photos
inputs.hint: Face close-ups and selfie shots, held and whipped on the beat.
inputs.query: a close-up selfie of a face looking at the camera

prepare: Close-up selfie clips, about 4 or more different ones work best
Videos analyzed, so the scene search can find the close-ups
